headline: High-Sulfur Fuel Oil Surges as New Cost Shock for Asian Trade
summary: Disrupted supplies and resilient bunker demand pushed high-sulfur fuel oil prices in Singapore above the price of crude used to produce it.
why: Singapore functions as the premier bunkering and shipping-fuel hub for Asian maritime trade.

impacts.name: Maritime Shipping
impacts.why: Elevated bunker fuel prices increase operating expenses for cargo and shipping carriers.

why_moved: Supply disruptions from the Middle East and Russia coupled with steady maritime demand drove refining spreads higher.
